components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Outlined secondary action that fills with ink on hover (Look up, Issue).
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { padding: 14px 22px; border: 1px solid #1c1915; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #1c1915; font: 500 11px 'Jost', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .32em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1), color .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: #1c1915; color: #faf7f1; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #8b6b43; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Underline Field
components.description: Label above, underline-only input; bronze underline on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; } .ds-field span { font: 400 10px 'Jost', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .26em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6b6256; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 0 12px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #d4c9b8; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #1c1915; font: 300 18px 'Jost', sans-serif; transition: border-color .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #968b7d; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #8b6b43; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Tracked uppercase links; a bronze hairline draws under the current page.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 32px; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 6px 0; font: 400 11px 'Jost', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .28em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: #6b6256; transition: color .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1); } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 100%; bottom: 0; height: 1px; background: #8b6b43; transition: right .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: #1c1915; } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"]::after { right: 0; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #8b6b43; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-timeline { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-timeline li { position: relative; padding: 0 0 26px 36px; color: #968b7d; font: 400 11px 'Jost', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .24em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-timeline li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 5px; top: 3px; width: 9px; height: 9px; border: 1px solid #d4c9b8; border-radius: 50%; background: #faf7f1; } .ds-timeline li:not(:last-child)::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 9px; top: 16px; bottom: 2px; width: 1px; background: #e3dbcd; } .ds-timeline li.is-active, .ds-timeline li.is-done { color: #1c1915; } .ds-timeline li.is-active::before { border-color: #8b6b43; box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(139,107,67,.16); } .ds-timeline li.is-done::before { background: #8b6b43; border-color: #8b6b43; }

narrative.overview:
Couture looks and behaves like the archive of a couture house. Designs are catalogued, framed and kept with care, never merchandised. The ground is warm paper. Type is a light, high-contrast serif set large and loose. Structure comes from 1px rules, not boxes or shadows. One bronze accent marks what matters: a seal, an active step, a link to proof. The pages read like an exhibition catalogue rather than a dashboard.

Every interaction is editorial and ceremonial. Sealing a design or issuing a certificate should feel like signing an entry into a register, deliberate and unhurried. Motion is slow and eased: things rise into place and lines draw across. Nothing bounces. Density is low, whitespace is generous, and one idea sits on screen at a time.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground with a faint grain, never pure white.
A light serif for every headline and a tracked uppercase sans for labels.
Hairline 1px rules carry the structure. Corners are square.
A hairline monogram "C" as the house mark.

rules.name: The Single Bronze Rule
rules.body: Saddle Bronze is the only accent. It marks proof, progress and the current place, and nothing decorative. If a screen has more bronze than a few marks and one rule, it is overused.

rules.name: The No-White Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are Paper or Vellum. Pure #fff and pure black never appear.

rules.name: The Serif Speaks Rule
rules.body: Anything a person reads as a statement (headline, title, verdict, empty state) is in the serif. Anything that labels or operates is tracked uppercase Jost. Nothing sits in between.

rules.name: The Proof Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Cryptographic values are always in monospace and shown in full, so they can be compared by eye.

rules.name: The Hung-Work Rule
rules.body: Only the design itself casts a shadow. Cards, buttons and panels never do.

dos: Do keep every corner square and every border 1px.
Do use Saddle Bronze only for proof, progress and the current location.
Do set statements in light Cormorant Garamond and labels in tracked uppercase Jost (10 to 11px, 0.22 to 0.32em).
Do show hashes, signatures and addresses in full, in monospace.
Do animate with the house ease (cubic-bezier(.2, .7, .1, 1)), slowly (0.3 to 0.8s, 1.4s for image zoom), and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Do give designs a 3:4 frame on Vellum with a Rule Soft hairline.
donts: Don't add rounded corners, pill buttons or card shadows.
Don't introduce a second accent color, saturated status colors, pure white or pure black.
Don't use bold weights for headlines. The serif tops out at 400 to 500 and runs light (300) at display sizes.
Don't put text or badges over the artwork in the gallery. Meta sits below the frame.
Don't use bouncy or springy motion.
